lines.en: A girl stands alone, pressed up against a wall and dressed in significantly less clothing than she’s accustomed to.
Clothing that was meant to impress not only the man she adores but those around her.
Not in a cocky way, but in a way that says “I’m comfortable in my own skin.”
As comfortable as one can be, that is.
Cold air finds its way out of brand new, industrial air conditioners that line the tops of walls in an otherwise ancient building.
That air reaches her legs and causes her to shiver.
She gets goosebumps.
She’s been extremely susceptible to those since she was a little girl.
Her mother was the same way.
Her sister, while less susceptible to them, was cursed with a slew of other issues.
The one pressed up against the wall wishes it were possible to trade places.
Getting goosebumps always makes her think of that.
But of course, that isn’t something worth telling anyone.
It’s not important at all.
Nothing’s important, is it?
A second girl shows up.
Her legs are cold as well.
But instead of letting her mind dwell on the depressing implication of goosebumps, she gets caught in thoughts of how fishnet stockings look best on girls with tanned skin.
It’s a thought much less personal than the girl on our right has, but it is a thought nonetheless.
That thought eventually transitions to how that girl must look underneath her costume, and the girl on our left attempts to break free from yet another sad delusion in the only way she knows how.
: Did you know, um...Pac-man was originally called Puck-man but...
: They, umm...wound up changing the name because they realized it would be...too easy to vandalize...
: Isn’t that from a movie?
: Yes.
: Hi.
: Hey.
: Did you come over here because I looked lonely?
: Whaaaaat? Noooo. Of course nooooot.
: I just happened to be in the area and...thought I’d drop by to say...you look really pretty tonight.
: Oh my God, so do you. I’ve been staring at your thighs all night, I’m not even going to lie.
: That’s, umm...
: Do you want to touch them?
: Hm? What was that last part? I couldn’t really hear you.
: What? Huh? There was no last part. The conversation ended after you complimented my thighs.
: I didn’t even respond.
: Rin...relax. You don’t need to act so weird around me.
: I’m glad you finally came to talk to me. I’ve been wondering when you were going to all night.
: You didn’t...notice me staring at you or anything, did you? Because I totally wasn’t.
: You totally were. We kept making eye contact for like, a split second before you'd turn away.
: That doesn’t sound like a thing I would do at all.
: That aside...are you having fun tonight?
: I am, yeah...I kind of love Halloween.
: Yeah, I kinda figured as much with all the skulls you wear and stuff.
: You don’t really...seem to be having a good time, though.
: Could Yumi not make it?
: You could have come...sat with us if you wanted.
: It’s just been Futaba and me for the most part.
: Molly pops in to say hi every few minutes but then just awkwardly walks away a few seconds later.
: Heh~ Thanks for the offer. I’ll keep that in mind for the rest of the night.
: Yumi’s actually on the way, though, so I think that might make things a little awkward for Futaba. Poor girl.
: Hey, you wouldn’t happen to know...why Yumi is always that mean to her, would you?
: I tried asking her on the beach and it didn’t really go well.
: I really wish I did.
: Literally the only thing I can think of is that Futaba doesn’t really stand up for herself.
: But that alone isn’t good enough reason to constantly bully somebody.
: Not like, there is a good reason to do that or anything. I just don’t really understand Yumi sometimes.
: Did you know it’s her birthday tonight?
: Yumi was...born on Halloween? That's so cool.
: That she was. Such a waste that she’s never even dressed up for it.
: So she’s coming to the party in her normal clothes? Like Sensei?
: Pretty sure, yeah.
: We better be careful or the two of them might bond over their shared interest in always being buzzkills.
: Yeah, right. Those two? They have just about as much of a chance as Maya and...literally anyone.
: I’ve never really talked to Maya before. Is she really that unapproachable?
: She’s not unapproachable, she’s just...Maya.
: It’s hard to explain.
A third girl shows up at the party, several hours late, and takes a spot between the two star-crossed lovers.
She has no costume, nor intent to don one, but is instead dressed in clothes that her mother used to wear before walking out on her.
But even if the girl in the center can’t seem to get over that small yet significant part of her life, she still needs clothes.
Because she, too, gets goosebumps easily.
: Finally! I was wondering when the Hell you were going to show up.
: Also, where are your manners? You totally just stepped between Rin and me while we were in the middle of a conversation.
: I’m cool with you blowing me off but at least say hi to her or something.
: Hey.
: You look nice.
: U-Umm! Thanks...
: You look like a slut.
: What?
: Aren’t best friends supposed to like, you know, compliment each other instead of making them feel like trash?
: Are they?
: Hah...
: Is Chinami asleep?
: Yeah.
: Did she remember your birthday at least?
: She remembered that you told her to remember it.
: And I see that she didn’t remember to not tell you I told her that.
: Nope.
: It’s whatever, though. It’s just a day and she’s just a kid.
: Happy birthday, Yumi.
: I’m sorry for getting all pissy with you on the beach.
: Thanks. And it’s whatever. I deserved it. I was a bitch that day.
: I mean, I’m a bitch most days, so it’s cool.
: How old are you now, if you don’t mind me asking?
: I’m-
: Oh, before you answer that question, I was wondering if you saw Sensei on the way in.
: He’s been gone for a while now and I thought he might be out there.
: If you’re worried about where he is, why don’t you just go look for him?
: He’s probably fist deep inside of one of the other girls right now.
: F-Fist?!
: Bullshit.
: Think whatever the fuck you want to think.
: Who else is missing right now? The rich girl? Class president?
: Well...Yeah, Makoto’s been gone for a while, too. But I don’t think they left together, did they?
: And even if they did, it’s Makoto. She’s probably just making him do...teacher stuff or something.
: The two of them basically set up the entire party, so they probably went to go get some more...drinks or something.
: Sure, whatever. Sorry for not telling you exactly what you wanted to hear. Please forgive me.
: Whatever. I’ll let it slide since today is your birthday.
: But no more saying mean things about the people I like.
: You fucking like everyone. You’ve gotta at least let me talk shit to somebody.
: I give you permission to talk shit to Chinami.
: Wha-
: You know I can’t fucking do that!
: That’s exactly why I gave you permission to do it.
: I don’t...need your fucking permission for anything!
: Yes you do or I’ll take your phone away.
: Chinami is...Chika’s little sister, right?
: Are you good with kids, Yumi?
: Not especially. I just hang out at Chika’s place all the time and she’s always there so...we know each other.
: Yumi’s just being tsundere. She likes Chinami even more than she likes me.
: I just fuckin’ said it’s only cause I hang out at your place!
: Just cause I won’t fuckin’ curse at a kid doesn’t mean I’m good with ‘em or like ‘em or anything! Give me a break!
: I had no idea you had a cute side, Yumi.
: I don’t! The fuck is up with you two?!
: I didn’t come all the way here just to get fuckin’ teased!
: You have any idea how long that walk was?
: Wait, you walked here? Is that why it took you so long?
: I left you money for the bus. What happened to it?
: I used it for something else.
: Don’t sweat it. I’m here now and I’ll ride the bus home with you as long as you’re paying.
: Can I...ride back with you guys, too?
: I mean, we literally live in the same building, so it would make sense.
: And Futaba is going to be staying at a friend’s place tonight, so it won’t be awkward or whatever.
: Do whatever the fuck you want. I don’t care.
: Just put a fuckin’ hoodie or something on so you’re not flashing everybody on the bus.
: Same goes for you.
: You mean you don’t want to be sandwiched between two beautiful, barely-dressed girls like you are right now?
: No. In fact, this feels really fucking weird for me.
: And it doesn’t help that you’ve both been staring at me pretty much this entire time.
: You look so cute in those clothes, though~
: Agreed. And I’m kind of an expert when it comes to calling girls cute.
: Even if I have zero experience with both men and women.
: The fuck does that even mean?
: It’s probably best for all of us if you don’t look into it.
: Ugh...fuck it. I’m just gonna go get some food.
: Noooo don’t leave us, we’ll miss you~
: I already do miss you! In an extremely platonic way, though. Obviously.
: Hehe~
: Hahah...hah...
: You might be a natural when it comes to teasing Yumi. Well done, Rin.
: You might be a natural at being...beautiful and stuff.
: Is that your pickup line for tonight?
: Depends. Did it work?
: I’d offer to let you come feel my heartbeat and check but I’m pretty sure you’d rip my costume off.
: To be honest, I’d probably pass out the second I smelled your perfume.
: It’s rosewater, actually.
: And lemon. You forgot the lemon.
: Holy crap, how do you know that?
: Oh! Umm, my sense of smell is just...really good!
: I totally haven’t looked through your bag while you were in the shower or anything!
: Oh my God...you’re hilarious.
: Hahah! Yeah! So funny!
: I’m gonna go die now! See you later, Chika!
: Pfft~
: Why me of all people?
